name: ERTH 5150
title: Applied Data Analysis in Earth Sciences
description: Multivariate spatial analysis methods and statistical inference in earth science, emphasizing how to translate conceptual understanding into computer code.
requirement_description: Recommended preparation: STAT 1000Q or 1100Q, GEOG 3500Q. Not open for credit to students who have passed GEOG 4150 or ERTH 4150.
